title: documentation/1.1/spec-request
description: Requests a document's table of contents, or one section of it. The default document is the DIDComm Messaging specification.

id.description: Message ID, unique to the sender.

from.description: Sender DID. REQUIRED when the message is authcrypted.

thid.description: Thread id; the id of the message that started the thread.

return_route.description: return_route extension; set to all to receive the reply on the same connection.

document.description: Document id from a table of contents' documents list, e.g. spec or extension/l10n. Omitted = spec.

version.description: The document's version, e.g. 1.0, 2.0, 2.1 or editors-draft for the spec. Omitted = its latest published version.

section.description: Section id. Omitted = table of contents.
